# Mitishell v1.0.1

Version 1.0.1 is a focused visual and media reliability update.

## Changes

- Long media labels now scroll reliably when animations are enabled. They use a stable right-side ellipsis when animations are disabled or reduced motion is active.
- Built-in shell icons now use consistent Nerd Font glyphs in the base text color. Their size follows the configured bar height across the bar and Settings.
- Playback controls and the bar clock render more sharply.
- Brightness labels and sliders use tighter vertical spacing.

## Install a prebuilt release

Download the archive matching your system and `SHA256SUMS` from this release. Then run:

```bash
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS --ignore-missing
tar -xzf mitishell-v1.0.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz
cd mitishell-v1.0.1-linux-amd64
make install-prebuilt
quickshell -n -p ~/.local/share/mitishell/shell
```

Use `mitishell-v1.0.1-linux-arm64.tar.gz` on arm64.
